faq.q: What is the origin of Ayoub?
faq.a: Ayoub is associated with Arabic. Variant romanization of أيوب, the prophet Job. The source record's gloss 'The one who calls, invites' is unsupported.
Yes — the underlying form أيوب is Arabic.
Ayoub can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Ayoub should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. أيوب is a prophet named in the Qur'an (4:163, 6:84, 21:83, 38:41)
